questions.stem_markdown:

Find the gradient of the curve at the point \((\ln 3, 2)\).

May already have used substitution $$\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{6y^2e^{-x} - 2e^{2x}}{12e^{-x}y - 12}$$. M0 for inclusion of an incorrect $$\frac{dy}{dx}$$.

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: Substitute for $$x$$ and $$y$$ to obtain an exact final answer

\[
\frac{1}{5} + 4\sin\theta\sin(\theta + 60^\circ) = 0.
\]
